hook.name: JurassicPlatformV4Hook
hook.description: Routes all exact-input swaps through the Jurassic Platform's external AMM (IJurassicV4Core) via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, fully bypassing Uniswap v4's concentrated liquidity logic and handling token settlement directly. Liquidity addition is permanently disabled; only pools registered and marked V4Active in the JurassicV4Registry can be used.
